subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification - MedCorp Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@medcorp.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo - security next steps

Hi Sarah / Tom - thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Recap: Demo focused on inference performance, data isolation (VPC option), and dedicated capacity for PHI-filtered workloads.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: 1) SOC 2 + HIPAA support, 2) ability to run in VPC/on-prem, 3) predictable latency for patient-facing features, 4) pricing transparency.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Security kickoff: we should loop in your security and procurement teams. Could you confirm the primary security contact and procurement lead?
2) Questionnaire intake: please share MedCorp's security questionnaire (or upload to the link below). We'll intake responses and map systems in/out of scope.
3) Stakeholder mapping: I'll add Rishi (security lead) and Dev (solutions engineer) to coordinate technical clarifications and the data map.

I've attached our SOC 2 report and a starter data map to speed intake. If acceptable, can we schedule a 30-min kickoff next week (Rishi + Dev + your security contact)?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood_soc2_cert_v2025.pdf; redwood_data_map_v1.xlsx

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@medcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medcorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@medcorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo - security next steps

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. 

Security contact: Michael O'Neal (michael.oneal@medcorp.com) - he manages third-party risk. Procurement lead: procurement@medcorp.com (cc'd).

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (MedCorp_questionnaire_v1.pdf). High level: we need SOC 2 evidence, encryption-at-rest and in-transit details, data retention and deletion policies, and an overview of systems that will touch PHI. Also please confirm whether Redwood can offer a BAA and options for VPC/private deployments.

Next: can Rishi and Michael connect for a 30-min kickoff on Tue 9/16 10:00-10:30 PT? If that works for you and your team, we'll confirm.

Best,
Sarah
Senior IT Security Manager, MedCorp Health
Attachments: MedCorp_questionnaire_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@medcorp.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medcorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up from demo - security next steps

Rishi / Dev - forwarding MedCorp's questionnaire and the ask from Sarah. Quick asks: 

1) Can you review the attached questionnaire and flag any questions that will require engineering input vs. legal/procurement?
2) Dev - can you prepare a short data flow diagram (mapping product components that may process PHI) and confirm which Redwood components would be in-scope for their review (e.g., control plane vs. customer VPC runtime)?
3) Rishi - please prepare a one-page summary for Michael O'Neal that covers SOC 2 scope, encryption, BAAs, and VPC/private deployment options.

We should aim to have those ready ahead of the kickoff on Tue 9/16 10:00 PT. I'll coordinate the calendar invite once we confirm availability.

Thanks - Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@medcorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up from demo - security next steps

Thanks for the forward - reviewed the questionnaire. High level notes: 

- SOC 2: we can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report (attached). Scope: infra, platform, control plane. We'll call out that customer data in Private/VPC deployments remains under customer control.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit. KMS integrations are supported for Private deployments; we use customer-managed keys for on-prem/VPC options when requested.
- PHI scope: we need Dev's data map to finalize which subsystems touch PHI. My assumption: Public hosted API (hosted.redwood.ai) will be out of scope for PHI; Dedicated/Private deployments will be in scope per your preference.
- Procurement: for BAAs we have a standard addendum; procurement@medcorp.com should review our template. If they need redlines, we can loop legal.

I attached the SOC2 cert and a short security summary for Michael to review ahead of the kickoff. I can join Tue 9/16 10:00 PT.

-Rishi
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_soc2_cert_v2025.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@medcorp.com>, Michael O'Neal <michael.oneal@medcorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@medcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medcorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Security kickoff invite + clarified scope (MedCorp)

Thanks everyone - calendar invite sent for Tue 9/16 10:00 PT (apologies for the time-zone confusion; invite shows local). Quick clarifications we'll cover during the kickoff: 

- Systems in scope initially: Dedicated Redwood runtime (customer-owned VPC option) and any integration points (S3 buckets, KMS, and identity connectors). Public hosted API will be out-of-scope for PHI unless customer elects to use hosted and sign a BAA - we'll discuss tradeoffs.
- Deliverables before kickoff: Dev to share a data flow diagram (1 slide) and a list of endpoints/components that will touch PHI. Rishi to share the security summary and SOC 2 evidence (attached).
- Procurement ask: procurement@medcorp.com - please confirm whether MedCorp requires any pre-execution PO, standard terms review, or a redline window for the BAA.

Attachments included: redwood_data_map_v1.xlsx; redwood_soc2_cert_v2025.pdf; MedCorp_questionnaire_v1.pdf

Looking forward to the call - I'll run the agenda and take notes.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
